item.title: We moved forty services off hosted observability
item.author: dmitri@news.example.com (Dmitri Sokolov)
item.description: A six-week migration, two engineers, and a bill that is now a third of what it was.
item.content:encoded:
We moved forty services onto self-hosted Grafana and Loki after the renewal quote came back at three times the previous figure, which was already the largest single line item on the infrastructure budget.

Ingest volume did not change at all over the period. The migration took six weeks and two engineers, and the resulting stack is materially cheaper to run than the vendor contract it replaced, even counting the engineering time at fully loaded cost.

The parts that hurt were not the parts we planned for. Retention policy, not query performance, is what took the extra fortnight.
